description: Build configuration for venues reconstructed from a trust's own published site-map sheet. Single source of truth for both scripts/maps/generate-all.mjs (which rasterises the sheet) and scripts/maps/build-venues.mjs (which places waypoints on it) — these were previously two hardcoded arrays that had to be kept in step by hand. Source PDFs are listed in data/plan-sources.json and downloaded into map/ by scripts/nhs/fetch-plans.mjs; map/ is untracked because the PDFs are the trusts' copyright.

fields.center: [lat, lng] the plan centre is anchored to
fields.plan: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalised crop limiting waypoint extraction to the site-plan area; the floor-plan image is always the whole sheet
fields.gcps: optional ground control points: [{ sheet: [x, y], world: [lat, lng], note }] pairing a normalised position on the drawing with the real place it is. Two or more replace center/spanM entirely and solve the ANGLE as well, which those two cannot express — a trust draws its site map to fit the page, not to face north. On a multi-floor sheet, put them on each floor instead. See docs/map-placement.md.
